meta.name: learn
meta.description: Distill a reusable skill from anything — a directory, a URL, pasted notes, or what you just did together — or refine an existing skill with new learnings. Use when the user says '/learn', 'learn this', 'turn this into a skill', 'capture this workflow', 'make a skill from <source>', or 'improve/update the <name> skill'. Produces or updates a .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md authored to NanoClaw's skill guidelines. (This CREATES or REFINES a skill from a source; it does not install existing skills from a registry.)

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从任何来源提炼或改进可复用的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把操作流程固化为可复用的技能
copy.tagline_en: Distill or refine a reusable skill from any source
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn workflows into reusable skills

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把一个目录、网址、粘贴的笔记或刚才的对话整理成一个可复用的技能文件（.claude/skills/…/SKILL.md）；若已有同名技能，则更新它而非覆盖。
howto.when: 当你说“/learn”、“learn this”或“turn this into a skill”等，或要求把某来源做成技能时触发。

say.text: /learn 这个目录，把它做成技能
say.note: Claude 会读取目录并生成 SKILL.md。
Claude 会抓取网页并整理操作步骤。

say.text: 把我们刚才的排查过程做成技能
say.note: Claude 会从对话中提炼可复用流程。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will turn a directory, a URL, pasted notes, or the recent conversation into a reusable skill file (.claude/skills/.../SKILL.md); if a skill with the same name exists, it updates it instead of overwriting.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say '/learn', 'learn this', or 'turn this into a skill', or ask to capture a workflow as a skill.

say_en.note: Claude reads the folder and creates a SKILL.md.
Claude fetches the page and extracts steps.

say_en.text: Turn what we just did into a skill
say_en.note: Claude distills the conversation into a workflow.
